title: UNBEATABLE Draft Strategy for EVERY PICK in 2026 Fantasy Football
sourceType: YouTube transcript supplied by the user
usage: Soft roster-construction prior; never overrides availability, league scoring, keeper cost, injury availability, or a material tier break.
principles: Use draft-slot groups to set an opening preference, then remain flexible to the board.
Aim for roughly three running backs and two wide receivers by the end of Round 5 in ordinary 12-team redraft builds.
Picks 1-2 lean elite running back; picks 3-5 lean elite wide receiver; picks 6-8 often lean running back; picks 9-10 lean wide receiver; picks 11-12 favor one RB and one WR at the turn.
Rounds 6-10 fill quarterback and tight end at value while continuing RB/WR depth.
Use the final three rounds for defense, kicker, and one upside lottery ticket when the league has 16 rounds.
Treat player-specific injury and depth-chart claims in the transcript as dated signals that require current verification.

modelApplication.openingSlotPrior: Small position bonus by slot group in Rounds 1-3
modelApplication.roundFiveBalance: Soft deficit bonus toward a 3 RB / 2 WR opening core
modelApplication.middleRounds: Small QB/TE fill bonus only when the starting slot remains empty
modelApplication.closingRounds: League-length-aware DST/K timing plus a final skill-player upside bonus
